97: # The stored association as four columns: a marker, then the complete rendering, the
98: # identity over the deciding members, and the result schema, each as hex, because a
99: # rendering is arbitrary JSON text and a tab or a newline inside it would otherwise split
100: # the tab-separated answer row. A row with no association answers the absent marker with
101: # three empty values.
102: def association_row_sql(+id: String) -> String:
103:   "SELECT CASE WHEN " ++ association_present(id) ++ " THEN 'present' ELSE 'absent' END," ++ "coalesce((SELECT hex(plan_value) FROM semantic_admissions WHERE query_id=" ++ C.q(id) ++ "),'')," ++ "coalesce((SELECT hex(plan_identity) FROM semantic_admissions WHERE query_id=" ++ C.q(id) ++ "),'')," ++ "coalesce((SELECT hex(result_schema) FROM semantic_admissions WHERE query_id=" ++ C.q(id) ++ "),'');"
